summary: Aptevo Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting multiple material definitive agreements entered on May 25, 2026. A collaboration and supply agreement with Niowave was signed to co-develop a therapeutic product combining Aptevo's molecules with Niowave's radioisotopes. Concurrently, Aptevo issued 98,522 shares of common stock and warrants for 53,201 shares at $5.075 per combined unit in a $500,000 private placement. No terms of a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or going-private transaction are present. The filing describes a routine partnering and financing arrangement, not a special situation.
